sticky_history_semantics: Every uniqueid in receipt or ACK unproved_history -> UNPROVED_HISTORY:<uid>; every ACK coverage_history entry i -> COVERAGE_GAP:<i>:<pid>; every ACK contract violation -> CONTRACT_VIOLATION:<uid>. No union status removes them; union UNRESOLVED rows only add UNION_UNRESOLVED labels. Receipt coverage_history/contract_violations must be exact typed prefixes of the ACK lists and receipt unproved uids a subset of ACK uids (else SUPERVISOR_ACK_INVALID). Communicated to ParentIdentityCP2 by IRC.
